events.title: Sound Bath Baby Storytime
events.description:
Babies and their caregivers are invited to a special Sound Bath Baby Storytime Takeover.

Bring your little ones and join us for a special 30-minute calming sound bath experience to nurture connection, soothe the senses, and support early development. This heart-centered session invites you to slow down, connect, and share in calming moments together with your little one. Gentle sound healing elements like soft crystal bowls, chimes, drum and gong sounds; create a soothing space for both you and your little one to relax and recharge. Sound healing can
support babies' sensory development, nervous system regulation, promote better sleep and emotional bonding. All caregivers welcome! Perfect for ages infants-2 but all children and adults are welcome.

Baby Storytime will resume it's normally scheduled programming on Monday, September 28th.

---------------------------------------------------------------

For this special takeover:

Dress comfortable
• Wear shoes that are easy to remove.
• Bring props (blankets, bolsters) to lie down comfortably
• Eat a light meal and hydrate beforehand.
• Listen to Your Body: If a sound is too loud or uncomfortable, it is okay to leave or move around.

Key Precautions & Contraindications
• Medical Devices: Those with pacemakers, defibrillators, or shunts should consult a doctor due to potential vibrational interference.
• Implants/Surgery: Metal pins, screws, or artificial joints might vibrate and cause discomfort. Post-surgical patients should wait.
• Pregnancy: Consult with and follow advise of medical professional/doctor
• Neurological Conditions: People with epilepsy or seizure disorders should exercise caution, as certain frequencies may trigger seizures.
• Mental Health: Individuals with severe, unstable mental health conditions or those prone to severe emotional triggers should consult a professional.
• Sound Sensitivity: Those with tinnitus or extreme sensitivities should use earplugs or sit further away from instruments.
